The Odyssey Film Crosses ₹100 Crore at Indian IMAX Box Office

The film 'The Odyssey' has achieved a box office collection of over ₹100 crore from IMAX screenings in India. This milestone makes it the first film to reach this figure specifically from IMAX showings in the country. Reports indicate that 'The Odyssey' has surpassed the box office performance of 'Oppenheimer' in India.
